subject: Vendor onboarding: Consolidated invoice schedule & early-pay pilot
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudbridge.io>, accounts@cloudbridge.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: consolidated invoicing & early-pay pilot

Hi Sam / CloudBridge team —

Welcome! We're excited to get CloudBridge onboarded as a Redwood supplier. To speed activation on our side and reduce monthly AP overhead, we typically consolidate charges into a single monthly invoice per account instead of per-project skewed invoices. Two quick asks to align: 

1) Invoice cadence: Can you issue one consolidated invoice on the 1st of each month that covers the prior month?s usage?
2) PO & remittance: We'll issue a single PO per legal entity. Please confirm the invoice reference you need on the PO (a single PO number vs. a per-project PO).
3) Early-pay pilot: We're open to a short pilot on early-payment incentives. Would CloudBridge consider a 1% discount for Net-15 payment (billed monthly)? We can run it for 3 months and evaluate.

I've attached our onboarding form and a simple CSV template for invoice lines (onboarding_form.pdf; vendor_CSV_template.xlsx). Can you confirm what docs you need from finance to set up ACH?

Proposed next steps:
- Sam: confirm invoice cadence and PO reference format by EOD Wednesday
- CloudBridge: return completed onboarding form + W-9 and banking stub
- Redwood: procurement (Aditya) will create PO and Marissa will run the vendor activation checklist

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf), vendor_CSV_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudbridge.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference>
Cc: accounts@cloudbridge.io
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: consolidated invoicing & early-pay pilot

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks for the clear note and the templates. We can absolutely produce a single consolidated invoice on the 1st covering the prior month's activity. A couple of clarifying items from our side: 

- PO referencing: We can accept a single PO number per legal entity. If you also need a cost-center/project line, we can include an itemized CSV (your template looks fine).
- Banking: We'll provide ACH details; we typically require a Vendor Enrollment Form from customers (for EFT enrollment) — is that what you attached? If you can send any specific vendor portal link, we?ll complete that.
- Early-pay: We appreciate the pilot idea. Our finance team has proposed a 1.5% discount for Net-15 (we usually price early-pay a bit higher). Would Redwood be open to 1.25% instead?

Forwarded for awareness: 
On Sun, Aug 15, 2027 at 09:02 AM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference> wrote:
> (original message)

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Head of Finance Operations
CloudBridge Inc.
accounts@cloudbridge.io

Attachments: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudbridge.io>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: consolidated invoicing & early-pay pilot

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the quick reply and flexibility. A few notes from Finance (so everyone is aligned):

- Consolidated monthly invoice on the 1st is fine. Please ensure each invoice includes: Redwood PO number, invoice date, invoice number, and the CSV attachment with ledger-level line items (your template works).
- ACH setup: Please complete the vendor_enrollment_packet (attached) and return with your W-9 and a copy of a voided check or bank letter. We'll send a DocuSign for the enrollment packet to speed things up.
- Early-pay pilot: Redwood can run a three-month pilot. We can approve a 1.0% discount for Net-15 payments. Conditions: 1) vendor must be fully enrolled in ACH before pilot starts; 2) invoices must be consolidated and include CSV line items; 3) the pilot will cover up to $250k in monthly invoice volume per entity. Finance reserves right to end pilot with 10 days notice if exceptions spike.

Action items:
- Sam: return vendor_enrollment_packet.pdf + W-9 + bank stub
- Aditya: please create PO once we have the enrollment packet (Aditya, confirm estimated PO creation ETA)
- Marissa: please run onboarding checklist and confirm when vendor is active in system

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_enrollment_packet.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: consolidated invoicing & early-pay pilot

Sam —

Great — thanks for agreeing to the cadence. We're good with the 1.0% Net-15 pilot per Laura's terms. I'm looping in Aditya to create the PO and Marissa to run vendor activation.

Marissa: can you confirm you have the onboarding packet in queue and estimate activation timeline (ETA)? Aditya: once Marissa confirms vendor is active, please create PO and share the PO number in this thread so CloudBridge can reference it on invoices.

I'll also send the DocuSign enrollment link to Sam separately. Sam, please return the completed packet + W-9 + bank stub as soon as you can so we can start the pilot for September invoices.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Next steps recap: 1) CloudBridge returns docs; 2) Marissa completes onboarding; 3) Aditya issues PO; 4) pilot starts for Sep invoice (paid Net-15 with 1.0% discount).
